Diego (Content): A: "Benchmarking Inference: 75ms median latency" B: "Ship features with predictable latency and lower cost". will run 50/50 and track CTR -> regs.
Riley (SDR): routing doc up: https://confluence.redwood.ai/sales/moonrise-routing. webhook verified.
SchedBot: scheduled X posts 1756822800 / 1756836600 / 1756880400; LinkedIn 1756834200. preview: https://app.redwood.ai/scheduler/1756789012
